case: Case A: Response concept with existing Schedule Studio full-app reference

implementation.source: Existing English-packaged seven-day application: src/main.tsx → src/App.tsx → ScheduleStudioPage, engine Worker and scheduleEvaluator/scheduleOptimizer.
implementation.evaluator: Declared synthetic audience choice and physical seat allocation; not a separately learned Response model.
implementation.search: Eight bounded rounds of validated neighboring schedules, reduced-particle screening and full evaluation of selected candidates; not the archived widget ILS and not BO.
implementation.revenue: Synthetic ticket plus concession units; not real currency or profit.
implementation.proposal: Original-design 44-slide Response presentation retained; broader concepts/prepared figures are not full-app verification.

currentBuild.sourceHashProvenance: Source tree hash calculated by the app rebuild; the builder verified the original application source was unchanged.
currentBuild.buildAndStaticChecks: Rebuild passed with identical demo checksum. English main and embedded Worker text were checked after decoding JavaScript Unicode escapes; no external demo dependencies.
currentBuild.independentHTTPUI: Pass for the single chained sequence and search/application observations recorded below; independent fresh repeat and other views not re-executed.

checks.name: Normal edit in chain
checks.input: From 10:00, +30 min once → 10:30; apply and re-simulate

checks.name: Opening boundary in chain
checks.input: From 10:30, −30 min three times → 09:00; apply and re-simulate

checks.name: Failure in chain
checks.input: From 09:00, −30 min once → 08:30; apply and re-simulate

checks.name: Recovery in chain
checks.input: From 08:30, +30 min three times → 10:00; apply and re-simulate

checks.name: Fresh independent repeatability
checks.criterion: Regenerate identical fixture and repeat the exact chain in the same runtime; compare KPIs/hash.

checks.name: Separately reset normal/boundary/failure cases
checks.criterion: Reset independently before each case; do not treat chained revision hashes as reset hashes.

checks.name: Return navigation
checks.criterion: All worked examples returns to ../index.html from full app and original presentation.
checks.observed: The app, its English guide, and the original proposal returned via visible All worked examples links to the package index under the /ie437/ course prefix.

evidenceBoundary: Executed current-build HTTP checks cover one chained edit/recovery/search workflow and package return navigation. They do not establish offline execution, an independent fresh repeat, learned Response accuracy, BO, causal effects, real business improvement or a global optimum. Prior separate-reset and slide-widget evidence was not reused as a pass for this release.

observationMethod.method: Independent CUA review of the current English Schedule Studio app served over HTTP; observations supplied by the root reviewer.
observationMethod.sequence: One generated fixture: baseline 10:00 → normal 10:30 → boundary 09:00 → failure 08:30 → recovery 10:00 → reference optimizer → apply candidate.
